item.title: ​Rufus questions evidence in impeach raps vs Veep Sara
item.description: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Rep. Rufus Rodriguez is raising red flags over the legal weight of impeachment complaints against Vice President Sara Duterte, arguing that allegations of plunder and graft lack sufficient constitutional evidence. The post ​Rufus questions evidence in impeach raps vs Veep Sara appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: Palace urges house to fast-track Barmm poll reset
item.description: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Malacañang is urging the House to fast-track a bill resetting the first BARMM regular elections to September 2026. SAP Anton Lagdameo Jr. stated that President Marcos Jr. considers the parliamentary vote a "top priority" for reinforcing democratic governance and regional autonomy in the Bangsamoro. The post Palace urges house to fast-track Barmm poll reset appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: 2 Chinese nab in Zambo illegal gold operations
item.description: ILIGAN CITY — Authorities arrested two Chinese nationals in Sibutad, Zamboanga del Norte, on March 3 for operating an unauthorized gold ball mill facility. The joint operation, involving the Bureau of Immigration and the 1st Infantry Division, revealed that the suspects were overstaying and engaging in business without valid permits, posing significant environmental and economic risks to the region. The post 2 Chinese nab in Zambo illegal gold operations appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: XU launches memorial fund for Mindanao demographer
item.description: Xavier University – Ateneo de Cagayan is set to launch the Dr. Magdalena Canag Cabaraban (MCC) Memorial Fund on March 5, honoring the 54-year legacy of a Mindanao research pioneer. The fund, which supports rising social scientists, will be unveiled during the closing of the 2026 PPA International Scientific Conference focused on population and climate resilience. The post XU launches memorial fund for Mindanao demographer appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: 2 foreigners nabbed for false Filipino identities
item.description: ILIGAN CITY — Two Chinese nationals were arrested for allegedly posing as Filipinos for 20 years. Authorities found the suspects using fake birth certificates and driver’s licenses to evade immigration laws and conduct business illegally in the city. The post 2 foreigners nabbed for false Filipino identities appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: Alagar says no serial acid attack in Oro
item.description: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) has assured residents that the recent acid-throwing incident on Villarin Street was an isolated, targeted attack and not part of a "serial" spree as rumored online. Regional Director Christopher Abrahano identified the suspects and warned social media vloggers against spreading misleading information that triggers unnecessary public alarm. The post Alagar says no serial acid attack in Oro appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: Photo essay: Shortcut to a growing problem
item.description: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Motorists using Bajas Road as a shortcut between JR Borja Extension and Lapasan Highway are facing a growing environmental eyesore. An abandoned lot in Sitio Cronin, Barangay Camaman-an, has evolved into an illegal dumping ground, with piles of unregulated waste accumulating right in the heart of downtown CDO. The post Photo essay: Shortcut to a growing problem appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: Barong, bravado, and one bad joke
item.description: OPINION - Just as the country opens Women’s Month, the Halls of Congress echoed not with dignity, but with a brand of juvenile bravado more suited to a locker room. The recent spectacle of filibustering and smirking approval for mockery under the national seal proves that for some lawmakers, respect is still considered optional. It is time to stop turning the House into a comedy bar and start practicing real leadership. The post Barong, bravado, and one bad joke appeared first on Gold Star Daily

item.title: Pag-IBIG Fund declares record P64.34B dividends for 2025; Regular Savings rate rises to 6.62%, MP2 climbs to 7.12%
item.description: Pag-IBIG Fund announces its highest-ever dividend payout of P64.34 billion for 2025. MP2 Savings hit a record 7.12% dividend rate, while Regular Savings reached 6.62%. Driven by a P65.28 billion net income, the Fund will begin crediting these historic returns to members' Virtual Pag-IBIG accounts starting this week. The post Pag-IBIG Fund declares record P64.34B dividends for 2025; Regular Savings rate rises to 6.62%, MP2 climbs to 7.12% appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: Laguindingan Airport adjusts parking rates, deploys more staff
item.description: Aboitiz InfraCapital has added personnel and designated pick-up zones at Laguindingan Airport to solve traffic bottlenecks following passenger complaints. The move coincides with new 2026 parking rates, including a P25 entry fee. The operator aims to improve the "passenger experience" as the airport expands to accommodate 3.9 million travelers annually. The post Laguindingan Airport adjusts parking rates, deploys more staff appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.
